directives.directive_text: Designate the exact DCSE_MASTER_PROFILE_v7_2_R5_FINAL.md artifact identified by SHA-256 2d6afe04be2f65f8d56d6b4b26c81e254e04171e3c94a40023b56b9236de36ae as the controlling DCSE Master Profile v7.2 R5. The embedded candidate label is build-stage provenance and does not override the later DCS authority decision.

Enforce v7.2 R5 as operative across governed model and agent surfaces; require task ID, Preflight Validation, D21 task declaration and Doctrine Consideration Log for every substantive task; preserve task identity across handoffs; and narrow the concluded-matter PS firewall so that protected-origin material is blocked from public-facing spill unless expressly authorized, while internal/private use remains permitted subject to confidentiality and access controls.

Adopt for immediate task routing the DCS Employment Opportunity & Package Methodology and the Thumbnail & Cover Asset Production Methodology created under DCS instruction on 2026-09-06. The exact current GitHub artifacts identified below are active by this express directive and DCSE-DDNA runtime reconciled. Formal D05 ACTIVE_RATIFIED promotion remains separately observable and requires attributable independent validation.

directives.directive_text: Require Closure Integrity Validation and a Completion Evidence Collector packet before any substantive governed task is reported complete. The executor must forward-chain executed actions, backward-chain claimed final state to required evidence, reconcile affected dependent artifacts and runtime records, and present direct human-review evidence including artifact links, commits or versions, material hashes, runtime or deployment evidence, validation results, unresolved findings, and required human decisions.

directives.directive_text: Amend the active DCS Employment methodology to add durable engagement tracking across all direct DCS revenue pursuits, and amend the thumbnail/cover methodology to define a workflow architecture whose normal output is a human-review selection set of three to five materially distinct candidates before refinement and finalization.

directives.directive_text: Amend and consolidate the v7.2 Runtime Harmony and Task Traceability directive so mandatory task intake metadata is paired with mandatory evidence-backed navigable final reporting, explicit goal-status and goal-shift reasoning, direct jump references to available GitHub, Supabase, Tribunal, Command Post, ESCD, deployment, doctrine, and rollback/history evidence, and default ESCD next-work prioritization with DCS controls to continue, skip, defer, reorder, or interrupt at any time.
